title: Implementation + organization
headline: We propose to release money in five gates from 15 December 2026, inside a ฿560 million net-new cap; a failed gate holds or cuts the next release.

notes: We propose releasing money in five gates from 15 December 2026. Net-new spend is capped at 560 million baht. A failed gate holds or cuts the next release. Gates zero and one test readiness: set-up and baseline. From gate two, we test results. Gate zero releases the first 155 million baht for Gen Z, tourist and CENTRAL X programmes. Gates one and two release the second half; gate three, the year-end season. Gate four, on 31 January 2028, decides the 2028 repeat. A proposed Plan Office under CPN's chief marketing officer owns the dashboard and the gates. Our sixth speaker covers the risks.
